title: fix(cli): don't report quests closed by others as "claimed"
author: patbing

gist.summary: `polli quests --claimed` now shows only quests with a reward record, rather than treating quests completed by others or retired as claimed. Completed quests without a reward show as dimmed `closed` entries, with a new `--closed` filter. A reward record also takes precedence over a stale `coming_soon` flag. On the account used for verification, `--claimed` dropped from 151 quests to 13, matching its reward records; `--closed` shows the other 138. The CLI skill reference and quest-status tests were updated.
